currentContext.expansion: The annual report discloses no capex project, plant, capacity addition, commissioning or ramp-up. The Company is asset-light and post-CIRP holds no fixed assets — the Board notes in response to an audit qualification that 'Post CIRP, the company has not received any fixed assets' and that fixed assets appearing in the books have accordingly been written off. Management's stated plan is to gradually scale trading activities, strengthen procurement channels and the supply chain network, and expand market presence in the food grains segment, with scope for diversification into value-added products; no site, capacity, timeline or rupee quantum is attached to any of it. The only balance-sheet-affecting corporate action disclosed is the opposite of expansion — the divestment of the material subsidiary Vintage FZE (India) Private Limited, approved by shareholders on 23 March 2026 and executed in FY2026-27.
